name: 92845 · Garden Grove, CA
findings: ZIP 92845 (Garden Grove) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92845 (Garden Grove) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92845 (Garden Grove) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
